effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your [Takuya Kanbara]s as if the Tamer is a level 3 red Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] This Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait, it gets +2000 DP.
